# OpenReview

> OpenReview is an open-science platform for peer review and academic publishing that hosts major AI and ML conference venues with transparent, community-driven review processes.

OpenReview.net serves as a centralized hub for academic conferences (ICLR, CVPR, ACL, AAAI, and others) to conduct open peer review, manage submissions, and publish research transparently. The platform operates with open-source principles and provides REST API access for programmatic integration.

## Getting Started

- [Venues](https://openreview.net): Main OpenReview homepage showcasing academic conference venues (CVPR, ICLR, ACL, IEEE ICRA)
- [About OpenReview](https://openreview.net/about): About page explaining OpenReview's mission, open-source model, and REST API capabilities
- [Venue Directory](https://openreview.net/venues): Searchable directory of academic venues (AAAI, AAMAS, ACL, ACM) hosted on OpenReview

## Community & News

- [A Message from AI Research Leaders: Join Us in Supporting OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum/pineau|a_message_from_ai_research_leaders_join_us_in_supporting_openreview): Fundraising appeal from AI leaders (Bengio, Ng, Pineau, Cho, Precup) supporting OpenReview
- [Survey Finds Broad Support for Greater Openness in AI Peer Review](https://openreview.net/forum/shah|survey_finds_broad_support_for_greater_openness_in_ai_peer_review): Research survey by Shah and McCallum on community support for open peer review practices
- [Initial Analysis of OpenReview API Security Incident](https://openreview.net/forum/user|initial_analysis_of_openreview_api_security_incident): Security incident analysis documenting API vulnerability and reviewer privacy impact

## Support & Contact

- [Contact](https://openreview.net/contact): Contact page for venue requests, bug reports, feature suggestions, and general support
